conclusion: Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) does not resolve attribution drift on VPN flows (Top-5 IoU remains at 0.3310 vs PTQ 0.3281, Spearman rho at 0.3850 vs PTQ 0.3610), demonstrating that attribution drift is a fundamental structural consequence of discrete weight quantization rather than an issue resolved by standard cross-entropy fine-tuning.
